subject.title: fix(context-engine): bound deferred turn maintenance with a per-task timeout (AI-assisted)

question: After the persistence-ordering repair, should OpenClaw accept `agents.defaults.compaction.turnMaintenanceTaskTimeoutMs` and the generic synchronous `onTaskTimeout` hook as permanent contracts?
rationale: The blocking state-ordering bug has a focused repair, but the new operator config and shared command-queue API semantics require human ownership and compatibility judgment.

options.title: Approve after lifecycle repair
options.body: Keep both contracts after the same-session checkpoint drains in-flight persistence and focused compatibility coverage passes.

options.title: Narrow the permanent surface
options.body: Retain the maintenance fix but replace either the config key or generic hook with a more local owner-approved mechanism.

options.title: Defer the timeout feature
options.body: Pause until maintainers choose a broader cancellable context-engine maintenance contract.

recommendation.title: Approve after lifecycle repair
recommendation.body: Keep both contracts after the same-session checkpoint drains in-flight persistence and focused compatibility coverage passes.
